reviews.title: Worst Service in Southeast Asia
reviews.text: They intentionally scammed us with our luggage even tho we've bought enough check in luggage. They were rude af and didn't even talked to us or informed us properly. Wouldn't recommend this airline. Just stick with another one. There are plenty nice airlines in SA. We're flying with a lot of airlines so far in SA and Air Asia was by far the worst customer service.
reviews.author: Thu H

reviews.title: Terrible support
reviews.text: The ticket was bought through airasia. The ticket was purchased from Korean air. I had to change the departure date, but airasia can't do that, so I tried to get my money back. 3 months no news on refunds, although Korean Air has no problem with refunds if requested. Support brazenly ignores all my messages, when I address my appeal, they just do not answer anything.
reviews.author: Mark K

reviews.title: Worst airline out there
reviews.text: i always pay for the highest in their economy but this airline should change their attitude. Ground staff is worst. Zero or no phone service. App never works. Pay money and forget. some people have written - pay couple hundred more and find another airline- totally agree. this airline needs customer service even claim to be a discount airline but with no workable app, no phone service, very bad hostile ground staff- Everyone should stop using this airline until they fix themselves
reviews.author: Ratan B

reviews.title: AirANXIETY! Don’t use this airline - pay a couple hundred extra for peace of mind.
reviews.text: If you don’t want to ruin your trip or have anxiety the entire time then do NOT book this airline. Firstly, a double booking was made due to a system error. They wouldn’t refund or even credit. We took that on the chin. YOU CANNOT GET IN CONTACT WITH STAFF ONLY POINT OF COMMUNICATION IS A CHAT BOT. Then, they cancelled one of our flights and pushed it to the day before - so we lost a day on this trip. No compensation what do ever - No worries, it is what it is. Thirdly, we board the plane - no on flight entertainment or food. Ok cheap airfare no worries can’t argue. So we stared at the seat in front for 9 hours. Then THE GRAND FINALE! Drum roll please…. They email us a day before we depart saying we owe money for the flight otherwise our return flight is going to be cancelled. The amount they’re requesting is $200 more than what we had originally paid. We tripled checked our emails to see if we made a mistake & all emails received from air Asia confirmed we had made full payment on April 20. So we’ve tried to contact them via their bot BO (which is their only point of contact) and they email us to advise that someone will be in contact with us to resolve the issue. We receive and email 3 hours later Thanking us for contacting them and to complete the process by making payment otherwise our flight will be cancelled. Now we’re on the way to the airport 8 hours early to try resolve this before these Neanderthals cancel our flight home. Not only have we lost a day on our trip but we’ve lost an additional half day to try fix this mess. Absolutely ridiculous - I look forward to contacting the Australian Consumer commission and raising this with the authority. They might be able to get away with this in India and other Asian countries where they don’t care about consumer affairs but I will ensure we escalate this further with the Australian Authority. Have a nice day 😄
reviews.author: Sam C

reviews.title: Request for Refund was denied
reviews.text: When I booked a flight to Ho Chi Minhnto Bangkok via AirAsia, I end up flying with Vietjet. I think AirAsia and Vietjet are codeshare. But something went wrong. My flight returning to Bangkok was 5:15 pm and I arrived at the airport around 1 pm. When I tried to check in to Vietjet desk, they said my flight had already left at 11 am. I got confused, AirAsia and Vietjet staffs cannot pin pint what went wrong. I requested for a refund from AirAsia and bought myself a one way ticket to Bangkok to Ho Chi Minh. Today, May 31, 2023, AirAsia replied to my request and said their deny my request since according to their T&C, my flight reservation was NON-REFUNDABLE. It's a warning for me and to all future passengers of AirAsia to have a travel insurance when flying with AirAsia Thank you for the dilemma and bad experience, AirAsia
reviews.author: Lightning_jack

reviews.title: Flight Dilemma with AirAsia / Vietjet
reviews.text: Warning! I recently had a hard time with Airasia. I booked my flight to Ho Chi Minh through their website but I end up flying with Vietjet. I wasn't bothered as I thought Vietjet is one of their codeshare airline. I manage to travel to Ho Chi Minh via Vietjet from Bangkok without a problem. Here's the dillema. When returning to Bangkok from Ho Chi Minh, my scheduled flight was 5:15 pm. I arrived early at the airport as friends of mine are catching their flight at 3 pm. When checking in myself on the airline desk of Vietjet, they said my flight has already flown at 11 am. I got instantly confused out of the blue. I insisted my flight is 5:15 pm and showed them my flight itinerary. I went to Airasia desk and they cannot even pin point the problem. The worse part flying with Airsia, if you have problem like this, you cannot call any hotline but rather wait for a live chat agent online. Worse, when I opened Airasia website, everything was in Vietnamese. I asked for assistance from Airasia personnel and I manage to contact a Airasia live agent. I told them my problem and they cannot even see the problem. Eventually, Airasia and Vietjet are pointing fingers to one another. So I left no choice but to request for refund which they say it will take 3 months. I said I don't care and I don't have a choice. In the end, I bought myself one way ticket to Bangkok.
reviews.author: Lightning_jack

reviews.title: Horrible customer service and communication
reviews.text: The lack of customer service and the use of a chat bot which is not advanced enough to deal with complex issues is frustrating. My refund has not been processed after three months, and the communication around cancellation of flight was terrible.
reviews.author: S16

reviews.title: Terrible. If you don't want to jeopardize your money, avoid this scam airlines at all cost.
reviews.text: Overcharged by 2x for overweight baggage than what is mentioned on their website. Secondly, uncivilized behavior of the reception staff. Thirdly, terrible management, I was about to miss my flight as they put 12am and 8pm people in the same row.
reviews.author: Yas Tih

reviews.title: WORST AIR LINE AND CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: I have tried to contact customer service for more than 20 times now. I have only managed to talk to a stupid bot that provides no information. I was taking a transit from phuket flight to Myanmar and i was held off for an hour for the un necessary documents (covid vaccine card) which they did not ask me for it while on immigration but to travel back they insisted that i need it to before i checked in. I managed to get a pic of my cert at last but they did not help me until everyone is done in the queue and at the end they told me to catch next flight caz my gate has been closed?? Like the plane takes off at 11:05 hows 10:35 gate closing time?? And its not that im late. They just hold me off to go back to my own country. I came without needing any documents few days ago there is no way they changed the policy and i did not know it. Im very furious with air asia. NEVER AGAINNN
reviews.author: Jenn T

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: We had a connecting flight to Mumbai, India so we arrived at the airport 3 hours earlier unaware that we had to get a visa for our layover in Thailand so we go to the check in counter and we ask if we can transfer our baggage because we didn't want to check in again and then they this small text on our booking confirmation that said "self transfer via visa" In off white colour. So we were furious as we thought we could get a free transit visa but instead had to get a Thai tourist visa which was 60 usd per person. We asked the airline staff at the check in counter for help but they were useless, useless to most minor detail! Then on the flight the flight hostesses were very rude and unhelpful,never again Thai Air Asia. Ugh!
reviews.author: Nigel

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: Worst customer service system I've ever seen. Would be nice to speak to someone and engage about the problem rather then that terrible bot.
reviews.author: nick Longstaff

reviews.title: Scam - not able to get a refund after cancellation
reviews.text: Flight got rescheduled to a timing where we would miss our connection. Agreed on a refund but after that all communication stopped. The chatbot is a disaster as well. Bottom line - They ripped me of - paid too much for not even getting on a flight.
reviews.author: Nick

reviews.title: Beware it's a scam airline! It sold to kiwi.com
reviews.text: We booked the tickets on official airasia site and what we discovered is that airasia partnered with kiwi and in fact you are booking the tickets via agency. No way to contact kiwi in case of any problems. No refunds, no customer service. Scam!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: Anna

reviews.title: Air Asia stole my money
reviews.text: We booked a flight with Air Asia in October 2022. Shortly afterwards they cancelled the flight, and ever since I have been trying to get a refund. Their 'customer service' is diabolical and they are just impossible to deal with. In March we were finally told the refund had been approved, yet we still haven't seen the money. Every email from them opens with an exuberant greeting and then a stock line about how it is still being 'processed'. It's now mid May and we haven't received a cent. As far as I can tell they have just stolen our money. Awful organisation.
reviews.author: Adam

reviews.title: This is the worst airline company ever
reviews.text: This is the worst airline company ever. I used a lot of airline companies but this is the worst airline by far even worse than Pegasus Airlines. I bought a ticket over their website I got an email confirmation but then I could not check-in because they can not find my ticket. I tried to reach them over the website but no way. I tried to call them and same no way. I left a message to call me emergency but guess what no way. My ticket waste it and I could not do anything even I could not reach them.
reviews.author: savaş k

reviews.title: Worst airline I’ve ever dealt with
reviews.text: They changed our flight and messed with travel plans. When we tried to change the flight to suit connecting flights. The app doesn’t work and we’re unable to change it. There is no contact with an actual person to help and their stupid Bo chat guy does nothing! Don’t book with them!
reviews.author: Taylor

reviews.title: Cant recommend
reviews.text: They change flight. 2 month before, i booked 4 month before After i book all hotels and everything. Want cancel and my money back... Still wait since 3 month for my money They tell me better take this money as an Credit for airasia then i will get money quick. I i want refund it should take 6 month or more. Never again!
reviews.author: Getaway531292

reviews.title: worst service ever
reviews.text: If you want to get in trouble - this is the best airline. Flights get cancelled and moved. Last time I flew to the PHP I got to spend the night in the airport waiting
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.title: Very bad customer experience, lost much money
reviews.text: My flight was twice changed. In effect I had to buy anothet tickets having a 3 times higher price and reshedule another flight which again costed money. I got a refund of my (3 times cheaper) flight but not on credit card but on Air Asia credit account. Moreover I will loose a day waiting at two airports for flights. Originally my two flights should take about 5 hours. Now it is 14. I absolutely do not recommend Air Asia.
reviews.author: Scenic227357

reviews.title: cancelled flight.
reviews.text: when booked originally had 7 hour stop over in Kuala Lumpur this was long but acceptable,then 4weeks before flight air asia cancelled second leg from K.L. to Siem Reap and put flight back 24 hors leaving me 31 hrs stop over in K.L.could not get any sense or joy from them,had to book accommadation near airport for 2 nights and taxi both ways at my expense plus lost a days holiday in Cambodia.The flights I took were typical budget airline no frills flights thats what I expected,Would not book with Air Asia again given the choice of another option,reading up later always canceling and delayed flights.
reviews.author: scubacol11

reviews.title: No refund after AirAsia changed my flight time
reviews.text: AirAsia changed my booked flight time to a time that wasn’t suitable for me. They offered me a free refund because of this which I requested. It has now been 60 days since I requested the refund and I still do not have my money back. I’ve had to book new flights without having the money back. Their customer service is shocking - you can’t get through to an actual person and only a chat bot that doesn’t resolve anything! Worse airline experience ever!!!! Never again
reviews.author: Megan W

reviews.title: Overcharged and stranded at the airport.
reviews.text: Attempted to book a flight from Kuala Lumpur to Cebu in advance of my arrival in KL on the 6th of May, flight is to be in August. Due to a computer error, my card was charged 5 times for the flight and the money was placed on hold. I’ve been stuck at the airport for 2 days because of this overcharge and can’t even afford cab fare to my hotel. Of course customer service at the ticket counter is of no help, they just said “send a text to Bo the automated robot.” I never thought I’d see the day when a flesh and blood human tells me to contact the computer to fix a problem that they should be able to handle. I’m canceling my flight and booking with another carrier.
reviews.author: Judy T

reviews.title: Bad customer experience ! Bad customer service
reviews.text: Tried to buy the ticket but charged me 3 times !!!!!!!!!!! On my credit card, this is absolutely madness ! also, tried to get money back, their after sales service is soooooo bad. I would avoid this airlines at all cost !!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: tazuka

reviews.title: unable to resolve issues
reviews.text: I didn't actually fly. I have a booking made through trip.com. However 3 days later my bank contacted me to say my credit card had been used for a further payment to Air Asia. As I haven't made such a purchase my bank has now blocked my credit card and will conduct a fraud investigation.The bank wanted me to contact aur asia to clarify what has happened. I have spent the past 24 hours trying to contact them by phone, email, facebook twitter all to no avail. Their website say to use an autimated bot but it is unable to deal with my issue. I have never experienced worse customer service. If you use air asia be aware that if anything goes wrong it is impossible to communicate with them
reviews.author: David F

reviews.title: Cost us fortune due to 3.5 hrs delay
reviews.text: Flight from langkawi at 10am delayed to 12.30 but actually took off at 13.30 that 3.5 hrs later . Hence missed my 15.10 to Dubai and then UK flights … If left on time or the initial 12.30 would of made it . I allowed the 3 hrs for delays but this was unacceptable I would of reschedule my other flights if 13.30 but was informed 12.30 depart . So cost me a fortune… IT WAS 3.5 hrs later not 2.5 as shown on departures board … SO MISLEAD THERE TOO . Never again , when speaking to other local passengers it’s a regular occurrence , delays and flight no show … Big mistake to flight with this carrier . Never Again…
reviews.author: Tiddlescat

reviews.title: Be very wary!
reviews.text: Flight was fine, this is why it gets 1 star. However, we were charged twice for our flights, this was in November, we immediately informed Air Asia of the error (after 'speaking' to the chatbot for about 30 mins, God forbid you try and speak to a real person!). They confirmed we were correct and needed a refund which they said they were processing. Monthly we have been back in touch, including in person in Thailand, they still say it is processing and we are due the money yet here we are in April and they still haven't refunded any! Every time you need to go through the chatbot first for an inordinate amount of time before speaking to a human, it is truly the worst customer service I have experienced and then you get fobbed off with excuses. I gave them 6 months before I said I would start reviewing them poorly and have advised them of this every time we have been in contact, all to no avail! So, let the review voting commence AirAsia!!
reviews.author: Greg D

reviews.title: Regarding refund
reviews.text: Hi dear Your booking No. 23264726761 (From Bangkok to Melbourne One Way) Passenger Name: MUSTAFA/HAFIZ ALI, SMAVIYA/HAFIZ ALI MUSTAFA No response from trip.com My flight from Lahore to Bangkok and Bangkok to Melbourne and Melbourne to Adelaide Flight was canceled by the airline I m looking for my refund it’s almost been 1 month now I m financially disturb please try to understand I need to rebook my tickets Please don’t giving me more stress Otherwise I m going to send email to Consumer rights of Australia I paid 1776.20 for 2 ticket I paid. 162.20 for laguage Many thanks
reviews.author: ali m

reviews.title: TERRIBLE,WORST AND RUDE CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: We had a flight this morning FD760 Don Mueang bound to Macau and I ask one of the staff if she can change me the seat because I am not comfortable with those people seated behind me and she told me you can choose and wait if there are any seats available since our flight is quite full.So I waited,(while I was waiting,I saw that there is a man seated on my designated seat,so I waited patiently and do not ask the help of the FA’s because they were busy at that moment)then upon observing them,Flight attendants are not checking the boarding pass and reminding passengers where they must seat and they just let you do your own.Unlike other airlines,they will help you to stow your baggage and seat on your designated chairs.Everything is a mess,passengers put there luggages everywhere not in the numbers that were assigned on them.When all of the passengers board already,I ask the other F.A(since there were 3) If I can possibly seat on the fire exit since I am capable of helping the emergency exits and been seated there for a few times ( I am a Bachelor of Science in International Travel and Tourism Management graduate and worked for how many years in this airline industry ) but she refused and told me that I need to pre-book the seats in advance however in there Air Asia App, when you finish the booking,the app will automatically put the seat number so how can we choose from those option huh?! Take off : The flight attendants are checking the seatbelts,seats etc. and the man infront of me recline his chair so the FA ask him to move the seat infront because we will be taking off shortly the man follow it and after a few seconds when the FA is gone,get back to being reclined again. As an FA,You should have the authority to tell your passengers and check everything once twice and you should remind them as a flying etiquette that do not recline your seat without the permission of the person at the back. I was so annoyed with this kind of service!!! Landing time : one of the passengers stood up 3 minutes after landing and the flight attendant literally SHOUT AT HIM from the back area of the cabin instead of telling him or use the telephone to sit down. That was really rude! And also they are using there phones watching movies LOUDLY, and talking on their own language LOUDLY! Is this really the way flight attendants do? I don’t think so, because I have some flight attendants friend too that not like them. Rude and at the same time terrible. I’ve been flying air asia whenever I go to my country and to Thailand but you ruined our trip! Really a BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE!!! Lastly, please clean your luggage area and change your attitudes!
reviews.author: Coco

reviews.title: Pay your money, maybe you'll fly
reviews.text: Air Asia will cancel or reschedule your flight at another time that doesn't work for you. If you don't like it, no money back. It's more like a lottery than an airline. AVOID AIR ASIA, pay a little more and get a reliable flight.
reviews.author: Triple Visor

reviews.title: ONE OF THE WORST AIRLINES EVER TRAVELED!!!!!
reviews.text: Basic Checking in itself is a great mess, absolutely no one to help, only one guy working for checking in for people of about 100+ and 2hrs long que just to check in! Adding to this Flight delayed almost 2hrs and absolutely no apologies from the airline! Poor and pathetic inflight experience as there’s no cleanliness in the flight and seats not working properly!!!!!
reviews.author: Dac S

reviews.title: Do not risk it
reviews.text: I would have given zero star if I could. I purchased tickets from Bangkok to Phuket and the flight was cancelled. I was put on another very late flight which didn't work for me because I was travelling with children. I cancelled and asked for a refund, after over a month, I still have not heard from them or have had any updates whatsoever. I could not reach any customer service who could assist or follow up. The only mode of communication is online chat with their AI which is pretty useless so at the moment I am still waiting for a refund.
reviews.author: kheinnaj

reviews.title: Absolutely Terrible, do not waste your money!
reviews.text: We booked this flight nearly 2 months in advance and planned accordingly, making sure to book for the afternoon (3.20pm) as we have a function in the morning, we get notified few days before that the flight had changed time to 7am. There was another flight that was flying to the same destination leaving 20 mins later (3.40pm), however they changed our one to 7am! We then got told that it would cost us a whole new ticket to change to the 3.40pm flight. This was their hope from the start, this is absolutely disgusting! If you are flying domestically in Malaysia, please do not for the cheap options such as this carrier, as they will randomly change times with little notice, and hope you purchase more tickets to adjust. Please consider other airlines, you will spend nearly £100 more by the time you sent to your flight!
reviews.author: Sai

reviews.title: Poor service. I would not recommend
reviews.text: The check in counter staff doesn’t know much English. Very inconvenient. Although they are operating international flights, they have zero knowledge about “reentry permit” and “visa”. They do not know the difference. Operates very slow and even though I try to explain the difference, they were still making a big deal out of it. Again, very inconvenient, won’t recommend to anyone, won’t fly again with air asia
reviews.author: Noley Naing

reviews.title: Stuck on tarmac because no buses
reviews.text: First time flying AirAsia. What a terrible experience on check in and especially arrival. Even on board it was a free-for-all. People sitting wherever which is great in the unlikely event of an emergency. Arriving at Bangkok even though there are many normal gates available, we parked as far away as possible and then stuck for 20 minutes because no buses were organized. They have fees for everything so why don't add a 'disembark at a normal gate fee instead of bussing but have no buses available.' Compared to Thai Smile it like RyanAir vs Qatar Air. So for us the first and last time.
reviews.author: Stumu

reviews.title: So great flight, best service and on time!
reviews.text: Great flight with Air Asia as always! Great staff and the flight was on time. Will absolutely recommend to fly Air Asia! Have travel some different airlines in Asia, and many of them are very good. The only airline I wouldn’t recommend is Bangkok Airways. Will never fly Bangkok Airways again. Especially due to not well informed check-in staff that didn’t have the knowledge about international destination policy, very unfriendly staff, flight delays and very old and not clean planes. When I fly Air Asia there are so clean planes, so great well informed staff, so great service and it’s definitely one of the best airlines in Asia you can fly with. Thank you again Air Asia for making it so nice and comfortable for your passengers from check-in to landing! Very great! 5 star service,, excellent!
reviews.author: Charleston Volo

reviews.title: A crook company
reviews.text: We booked our flight from Bangkok to Da Nang with a high Premium Flex surcharge. One reason was the included special check-in at an extra counter, because we didn't want to stand in a long line. However, there is no Air Asia Premium Check-in Counter at Danang Airport. A friendly employee explains to us that there has never been anything like this here. So, we got in line. Air Asia charges guests for a service with the clear knowledge, that they will not provide it. This is outright fraud, and the airline enriches itself in a criminal way.
reviews.author: georgmichaelbangkok

reviews.title: Canceled flight, no refund from Air Asia!!! NEVER AGAIN AIRASIA
reviews.text: AirAsia canceled my flight. Asked them for refund, it is almost a year and still didn't receive refund! NEVER AGAIN AIR ASIA!
reviews.author: Jaka

reviews.title: Impossible to talk to a human
reviews.text: My flight ws rescheduled and I had the right to cancel it. However, it is IMPOSSIBLE to get in touch with a human at Air Asia. You can only chat with "Bo" the bot. There is no phone number, there is no e-mail. It's a bot at social media. Should not be legal to not display any way of getting in touch with a human. NEVER Air Asia again. Will gladly pay double or triple the fair for another airline.
reviews.author: Jon E

reviews.title: I wish I'd read these reviews
reviews.text: I wish I'd read these reviews earlier. Our flight from Vientiane to KL was cancelled. I requested a refund a couple of months ago – still pending. No way to contact Customer Service. They just keep your money. They're a deeply unethical company – as evidenced by all the reviews here.
reviews.author: Mezzeman

reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN!!!
reviews.text: I'm a frequent flier. And by frequent, I mean I fly several times a month some months. Mostly business but sometimes leisure with me and the husband. I'm a comfy flier with both international and domestic flights, used to turbulence and weird sounds- not much bothers me. That being said, this flight had me unnerved and nauseous. The flight started off with being an hour late for takeoff and having to sit on the tarmac for 20 of those 60 minutes. No big deal, delays happen. When the pilot took off it was the weirdest thing I had ever experienced, it was as if he could not keep the plane going in a straight line down the roadway. No exaggeration, we were doing a light swerve as we accelerated for takeoff. We got into the air and I'm surprised he didn't cause an aerodynamic stall by how quickly and vertically he climbed. The seatbelt sign was turned off approximately 3 minutes into the flight. Yes, you are reading that right, 3 minutes. At this point, the plane wasn't even perfectly level it was still nose up! The entirety of the 1 hr 20 min flight continued unleveled, feeling as if we were either nose up or nose down at any given point. Turbulence was pretty bad in most areas but made worse by the fact that the pilot was flying faster than needed because he was trying to make up for lost time. As we descended for our landing, he descended so sharply and broke through the clouds so quickly that it jolted the plane and everybody gasped and you could hear luggage shift. Next thing you know, we're climbing back up into the clouds! He did this number twice more before finally remaining in a constant descent. The last 15 minutes of the flight was full of very sharp turns where it felt like the wings of the plane were vertical. Everybody was looking around trying to figure out what the hell was going on. He would then level back out so abruptly that it made you sick. He did this countless times prior to landing. it was almost as if we went in a full circle to be honest but I'm sure he was just changing direction so we could land. The wings of the plane swayed side to side as we got closer to the runway, the landing was hard and once again, the pilot was unable to keep the plane going in a sem- straight line. I read horror stories about this airline and was very hesitant to take the flight the night before but we decided to take the flight against our better judgment because we found something that said that since all of the incidents that AirAsia had had over the years, their parent company and all subsidiaries had become certified and they had registered with the IATA for safety audits. Oh! And the seat spacing isn't the same standard as most airlines, maybe because Asians tend to be smaller in stature? I'm only 5'8" and should have taken an exit row seat like my 6'7" husband, as my knees were hitting the chair in front of me. Anywho, never again, pilot got his license out a Crackerjack box.
reviews.author: Ann D

reviews.title: no confort
reviews.text: This is a real budget airline, don't expect any confort even on longhaul flights. No food, no drinks, no pillow, no movie, nothing. You can pre order some food minimal 24h in advance. We did but is diddn't make us happy.
reviews.author: Paul L

reviews.title: Avoid those thieves at any cost
reviews.text: If you ever need to change your flight, you are stuck with purchasing another one way ticket at a very expensive rate. You can not change tour departure online, you cannot reach anyone by phone, their BOB online chat is useless and keep sending you in cycles to nowhere till you give up. Professional thieves. Avoid them.
reviews.author: Walid A

reviews.title: Trash Airline
reviews.text: Didn't realize Singapore does not allow entry into their country if passport is expiring in less than six months. I booked a ticket from Phuket to Singapore and paid $220. A few days before my flight departure, an email was sent to put in my passport info, hotel name/address, etc. I couldn't complete the form because of the expiration date on my passport. I get to the airport and the agent will not issue me a boarding pass. I asked why didn't AirAsia ask for passport info prior to purchasing the ticket and she suggested that it was my fault for not researching the country's travel restrictions. Ok fine, I'll accept my negligence, however, they would not allow me to change the existing reservation to fly to Bangkok in order to get to the US Embassy. They simply took the $220 and said next customer. Worst airline, book at your own risk.
reviews.author: Tara

reviews.title: Many schedules offered for very few flights at the end
reviews.text: We booked a flight with Air Asia, from Sandakan to Sydney. Departure from Sandakan at 18:25 pm. We chose this flight, on Air Asia, because it had a short layover in Kuala Lumpur and a limited travel time. We paid more for this option. Air Asia has informed us that the flight from Sandakan will be rescheduled to 10:20 am, with a stopover of 10h in Kuala Lumpur. If we had wanted such a long layover, we would have chosen another option, with a cheaper price. We received no explanation or apology from the company It was then impossible to unsubscribe from the advertisements sent almost daily by Air asia. In the last advertisement, Air Asia offered us partner hotels, to avoid staying at the airport during a too long layover. I didn't realize that Air Asia had increased the layover, on purpose, to be able to sell partners hotel rooms. GIVEN THE QUESTIONABLE BUSINESS PRACTICES, I WILL NOT RECOMMEND AIR ASIA TO ANYONE.
reviews.author: Philou Le Grigou

reviews.title: They screwed me for 256 US dollar and they won't reimbourse me
reviews.text: They charged my credit card for 260$ US and they won't reimbourse me for the mistake. Reaching customer service has been a NIGHTMARE! They simply don't want to deal with any issue. I will certainly never fly with them again .
reviews.author: Ariane B
reviews.route: Ho Chi Minh City - Luang Prabang

reviews.title: Complete trash
reviews.text: They don't even have CUSTOMER SERVICES anymore. No help no matter what country you call or how bad you need to talk to a human. New policies seem to pop up with whoever is in charge at the time LAST TIME I SPEND MY MONEY HERE
reviews.author: Kamel E

reviews.title: They do not support child safety
reviews.text: They charge extra to take a child car seat. Most airlines do not charge for a car seat. It's really disappointing that this airlines does not help or support child safety.
reviews.author: Jo S

reviews.title: Worst compagny ever
reviews.text: Bought a flight to Seoul , with a transit via Vietnam for an hour transit. The staff requested a Visa to Vietnam for the transit . Wich is not according to international law. And refused my check in. While the staff member at counter was laughing with her collègue . They offered another solution , Wich was. Buying another ticket direct to Seoul and loosing the one I paid for. They didn’t want to give a proof of refusal to register. So basically no refund and no proof . I recorded the counter registration with the time of my flight for challenging their mistake. They rudely asked for my phone so they would erase the video .I refused and they called the police. This is the worst compagny ever.
reviews.author: samir o

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Travelled Air Asia return Perth- Bali. Never again - old planes, no TV screens etc. We were on our honeymoon and they seated us separately in different rows for our return flight. When I discovered this upon checking in online one week before the flight,I tried to contact them via phone/email. You simply can't contact them!!!! Even their online chat can't assist you - he just asks for your credit card details. Like I said never again - pick a different airline because if you need any help to change anything, you can't!!!!!
reviews.author: simwa2018

reviews.title: Baggage fee extortion.  Willfully punishing to customers.
reviews.text: Last time I flew this airline they almost gleefully and mercilessly derailed my trip to India in 2020. Wouldn’t accept the visa although it was valid. Needed to contact the India embassy to send an email. Happened to find someone to help otherwise no trip. Complete careless ignorant incompetence. Two nights ago flew them again by accident. Long story but I wound up with a ticket on AirAsia. I tried to buy baggage on the website prior to the flight twice. It kept hanging so no way to do it. When I booked I also tried but the site required some sort of credit to do so. Got to counter and they gleefully and mercilessly told me to pay over 25,000 rupees - over $300 for one bag. Almost 3 times the ticket price. Was told this is their business model. I paid as I had no choice and will dispute with my credit card company. Total scam. Their baggage fee structure is a dizzying maze. The plane looked frightening. Disgusting. Decrepit. I paid extra for a seat with no armrest. You cannot recline. It’s falling apart. It smells. It’s a flying jail cell. Never ever again. I’d rather not go than be subjected to this “airline”. Their people are trained to be ruthless and spiteful. I think they get paid a commission on baggage fees. The only thing I’m grateful for is the plane took off and landed safely and I was forever freed of that garbage dump. Any positive review for this airline must be fake.
reviews.author: debra056
